preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and line.strip().isdigit() for line in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Each line in the input consists of a single integer.

preconditions.expression: all(int(line) > 61 and int(line) < 10**6 for line in stdin.splitlines()[:-1])
preconditions.description: Each odd number in the input is greater than 61 and less than 10^6.
Each number in the input is odd.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and line.strip().isdigit() for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line in the output consists of three integers separated by spaces.
Each line in the output contains exactly three numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line.split()[0]) + int(line.split()[1])**2 + int(line.split()[2])**3 == int(input_line) for input_line, line in zip(stdin.splitlines()[:-1], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: For each input number, the sum of a prime, a square of a prime, and a cube of a prime equals the input number.

postconditions.expression: all(all(is_prime(int(num)) for num in line.split()) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line != '0 0 0')
postconditions.description: Each number in the output triplets is a prime number.

postconditions.expression: all(line == '0 0 0' or any(int(line.split()[0]) + int(line.split()[1])**2 + int(line.split()[2])**3 == int(input_line) for input_line in stdin.splitlines()[:-1]) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: If no valid triplet exists for an input number, the output is '0 0 0'.
